Measure how long an ad keeps running
Research targeting by country and audience

faq.q: Is there an official TikTok Ad Library API?
faq.a: Yes, the Commercial Content API, for approved researchers and developers. This actor needs no approval: search by keyword, advertiser or link and get each ad with dates, audience size and creatives.

faq.q: Can I use it as a TikTok Ad Library API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: TikTok's Commercial Content API gives Ad Library data to approved researchers and developers only. This actor reads the public TikTok Ad Library without an application.
